invariants.title: Facing
invariants.rule: the jester faces screen-left (toward her), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: a take keeps the facing its two frames give it; the duel's were mirrored by a bug

invariants.title: It starts where the last shot ended
invariants.rule: the jester starts where 010 left him.
invariants.why: a relay: each leg takes the moment from the one before

invariants.title: Its leg of the relay: answer
invariants.rule: The other side reacts - story time 6 to 9 s.
invariants.why: LTX_PLAYBOOK §101: every shot is a leg of one moment; an echo repeats time already told

invariants.title: The baton it hands on
invariants.rule: His look down - to the ground at her feet (040).
invariants.why: the next shot picks it up - without it the cut is a jump

invariants.title: He looks down
invariants.rule: His eyes drop toward her feet: the next shot is what he sees.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: each leg's length is its share of the story time

flair.title: Seed
flair.note: free - the takes differ by seed

flair.title: Timing inside the shot
flair.note: the beats may land a few frames early or late

flair.title: How far the place has burned
flair.note: the dress for this shot: dusk (dusk, red, burning, volcanic - it only ever gets worse)

flair.title: Sound
flair.note: H3's own: a faint whispered incantation, his amused hum.

title: amused
beat: He thinks it is a trick, and he likes tricks. [answer · story t 6-9 s · baton: his look down - to the ground at her feet (040)] (shot 3 of 23)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_test.py render + cast --ends), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set; the place's state from the shot's dress
